CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "document".document( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, company_id UUID, template_id UUID, number TEXT, status TEXT, price DOUBLE PRECISION, deleted BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_modified_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version BIGINT );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "document".document_value( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, position INTEGER, value TEXT, document_id UUID, template_id UUID, template_field_id UUID, key_name TEXT, deleted BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_modified_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );
